about: Models allowed in this project (brief §4e, principle 3). Each records its license and whether its weights are open; open-weight models are preferred. A model is added only by a reviewed change that quotes the license line from the model's own card, and only if that license clearly allows publishing outputs under GPL-3.0. The composer offers only these; every recipe records the exact model and revision. Hosted models run on a third party's servers; for them the recipe's model record is the endpoint, the date and the host's request id. Local models stay preferred when they can do the job.
